name: find_contact
summary: Search Contacts.app by name and return matching people with their phone numbers (and labels like mobile/home/work). Use this to discover the exact number to dial, or to let the user disambiguate when a name is ambiguous.

params.name: name
params.description: Name (or part of a name) to search for in Contacts.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of matching people to return (default 20, maximum 50).

name: call
summary: Place a phone or FaceTime call. STAGED for confirmation before anything is dialed (initiating a call is irreversible; there is no undo). Provide EITHER an explicit number OR a contact_name (resolved via Contacts at confirmation time). Choosing the method: default to 'cellular' (places the call through a paired iPhone via Continuity); if no iPhone is available or the person is better reached on FaceTime, use 'facetime_audio'; use 'facetime_video' only when the user explicitly asks for a video call or 'a FaceTime call'.

params.name: method
params.description: How to place the call. 'cellular' = phone call via a paired iPhone (the default). 'facetime_audio' = FaceTime audio (use when cellular isn't available or the contact is an Apple user reached on FaceTime). 'facetime_video' = FaceTime video (only when the user explicitly asks for a video / FaceTime call).

params.name: number
params.description: Explicit phone number to call. Provide this OR contact_name, not both. Digits, with an optional leading '+' and spaces/dashes/parentheses; no letters.

params.name: contact_name
params.description: Name to look up in Contacts and call. Provide this OR number, not both. If the name matches more than one person, or one person with more than one number, the call is refused and the candidates are listed so you can retry with an explicit number.
